top_signals.title: Sfakianakis: Iran Misjudges US Willingness for Long War
top_signals.summary: The Trump administration is preparing to unveil its campaign to economically isolate Iran including plans to extend the strategy to countries that continue trading with Tehran such as China. John Sfakianakis, Chief Economist and Head of Research at the Gulf Research Center spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East and Africa on the GCC ties to Iran. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japan's historic yen intervention has ‘turbo-charged’ the carry trade
top_signals.summary: Japan's historic effort to prop up the yen may have had an unintended consequence: giving investors a better opportunity to put the carry trade back on.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
